bull_bear.body:
- Net worth stated at ₹98 Cr, "↑ +66% YoY", "supported by reserve reinvestments and Main Board migration capital".
- Balance-sheet metrics as stated: Debt to Equity 0.08x, Interest Coverage 4.35x, Asset Turnover 1.19x, Current Ratio 1.76x, ROCE 15% ("↑ +4% YoY"); leverage described as "Conservative".
- Capital is being redeployed into subsidiaries rather than owned fleet — solar EPC setups, hotel asset upgrades and warehouse hubs — consistent with the stated no-capital-in-vehicles model.
- The deck makes no mention of dividends, buybacks or a stated payout policy.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Describes itself as "India's Leading ISO 9001:2015 Certified Logistics Company" with a vision to be "India's most trusted, tech-driven logistics conglomerate"; mission framed as "ensuring zero cargo damage and seamless delivery".
- Credentials cited as durable barriers: IBA (Indian Banks' Association) approval allowing clients to use GICL Lorry Receipts for banking and trade finance, ISO 9001:2015 quality systems, and an NSIC-CRISIL SE-2B rating "validating high-performance execution capability and financial stability for long-term contracts".
- In February 2026 GICL migrated to the NSE Main Board, described as "a major governance milestone"; the deck also notes it was "the very first logistics enterprise from Rajasthan to list on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) SME Platform" (2016).
- Client base described as 200+ Global B2B Clients; top-10 client sector mix given as Power Trasmission 24%, Wholesale Trade 19.9%, Metals & Mining 18.1%, Renewable Energy 17.4%, Industrial EPC 14.9%, Electrical & Manufacturing 5.7%.
- Stated addressable market: "₹21L Cr Market TAM" across 6 service verticals.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [M&A] 2018 acquisition of Intraglobe Transport Solutions Private Ltd. as a wholly owned subsidiary; 2024 establishment of Intraglobe Green Energy Private Ltd. as the solar EPC division.
- [Listing] Journey stated as founded 1966 as Globe Road Carriers, incorporated 2010 as Globe International Carriers Private Ltd., NSE SME (Emerge) listing 2016 ("oversubscribed"), NSE Main Board migration 2026. Cover letter cites Symbol GICL, ISIN INE947T01022, NSE: GICL / BSE: 538385 / CIN L60232RJ2010PLC031380.
- [Governance] Board includes three Non-Executive Independent Directors (Suneel Sayarmal Mohnot, Sanjay Jindal, Rajendra Kumar Agrawal); KMPs are CFO Saloni Agrawal, CS Annu Khandelwal, Whole-Time Director Surekha Agrawal and Executive Director Shubham Agrawal — a largely promoter-family executive team.
- [Risk factors] Safe-harbour names the deck's own risk list: "changes in shipping tax rates, state border delays, fuel pricing, macro industrial production cuts, or credit terms with B2B clients".
- [IR] Investor relations is outsourced to BlueChariot Investments (ir@bluechariotinvestment.in).
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions GICL as an asset-light, ISO 9001:2015 certified pan-India logistics aggregator with 60+ years of heritage, now a tech-driven conglomerate whose real estate/hospitality and solar EPC subsidiaries hedge cyclical freight.
